title: Phonics - Consonant Sounds (ph, ch, wh, st)
subject: Language Arts
curriculum: Jamaica NSC Grade 2 - Integrated Phonics Workbook (Part 2)

sections.title: Initial 'ph' Sound
sections.description: The 'ph' at the start of a word sounds like the letter 'f' — as in 'phonics'

questions.prompt: The letters 'ph' make the sound of which letter?
questions.hint: Say 'phone' — it sounds like it starts with 'f'

questions.prompt: Which word BEGINS with the 'ph' sound?
questions.hint: Look for the word spelled with 'ph' at the start

questions.prompt: The subject where we learn letter sounds is called ___.
questions.hint: It starts with 'ph' and sounds like 'fonics'

questions.prompt: A person who gives out medicine at a pharmacy is a ___.
Which word starts with the 'ph' sound?
questions.hint: A phantom is a make-believe ghost — it starts with 'ph'

questions.prompt: Fill the blank: We use a ___one to call people far away.
questions.hint: The word is 'phone' — it starts with 'ph'

questions.prompt: The name 'Phillip' begins with the ___ sound.
questions.hint: Phillip is spelled with 'ph' at the start

sections.title: Medial 'ph' Sound
sections.description: The 'ph' sound in the MIDDLE of a word — as in 'telephone'

questions.prompt: A big grey animal with a long trunk is an ___.
questions.hint: It has 'ph' in the middle — el-e-PH-ant

questions.prompt: You use it to talk to people far away by holding it to your ear.
A smart sea animal that jumps out of the water is a ___.
questions.hint: dol-PH-in has the 'ph' sound in the middle

questions.prompt: All the letters from A to Z together are called the ___.
Which word has the 'ph' sound in the MIDDLE?
questions.hint: The 'ph' is between other letters, not at the start or end

questions.prompt: Fill the blank: The dol___in swims in the sea.
questions.hint: The word is 'dolphin' — 'ph' goes in the middle

sections.title: Final 'ph' Sound
sections.description: The 'ph' sound at the END of a word — as in 'photograph'

questions.prompt: A picture you take with a camera is a ___.
Which word ENDS with the 'ph' sound?
questions.hint: Look for the word that finishes with 'ph'

questions.prompt: A group of sentences about one idea is a ___.
Which word ends with the 'ph' sound?
questions.hint: telegra-PH ends in 'ph'; telephone has 'ph' in the middle

questions.prompt: The name 'Ralph' ends with the ___ sound.
questions.hint: Ral-PH finishes with the 'f' sound spelled 'ph'

questions.prompt: Fill the blank: We drew a bar gra___ in class.
questions.hint: The word is 'graph' — it ends with 'ph'

sections.title: Initial 'ch' Sound
sections.description: The 'ch' sound at the START of a word — as in 'chain'

questions.prompt: A baby hen is called a ___.
We sit down on a ___.
Which word BEGINS with the 'ch' sound?
questions.hint: Look for the word that starts with 'ch'

questions.prompt: A sweet brown treat many children love is ___.
Small red fruits that often grow in pairs are ___.
People who come from China are called ___.
Fill the blank: We use a metal ___ain to lock the gate.
questions.hint: The word is 'chain' — it starts with 'ch'

sections.title: Medial 'ch' Sound
sections.description: The 'ch' sound in the MIDDLE of a word — as in 'teacher'

questions.prompt: The person who helps you learn at school is your ___.
A chair on wheels for a person who cannot walk is a ___.
questions.hint: wheel-CH-air has the 'ch' sound in the middle

questions.prompt: A place where fruit trees are grown is an ___.
A person who cuts and sells meat is a ___.
questions.hint: but-CH-er has the 'ch' sound in the middle

questions.prompt: A large jug used to hold water is a ___.
Which word has the 'ch' sound in the MIDDLE?
questions.hint: The 'ch' is between other letters, not at the start

questions.prompt: A dog kept to guard a building is a ___.
questions.hint: wat-CH-dog has the 'ch' sound in the middle

sections.title: Final 'ch' Sound
sections.description: The 'ch' sound at the END of a word — as in 'teach'

questions.prompt: A long seat for two or three people in a park is a ___.
A soft, juicy fruit with a fuzzy skin is a ___.
The meal we eat in the middle of the day is ___.
A small clock you wear on your wrist is a ___.
The sandy place beside the sea is the ___.
Which word ENDS with the 'ch' sound?
questions.hint: chur-CH ends with 'ch'; the others only start with 'ch'

questions.prompt: Fill the blank: Mom sewed a ___ over the hole in my jeans. (pat__)
questions.hint: The word is 'patch' — it ends with 'ch'

sections.title: Initial 'wh' Sound
sections.description: The 'wh' sound at the START of a word — as in 'whale'

questions.prompt: A very big animal that lives in the sea is a ___.
You blow it to make a loud sound at a game. It is a ___.
The colour of snow and milk is ___.
It is round and turns on a bicycle or a car. It is a ___.
To talk very softly and quietly is to ___.
A garden tool with one wheel and two handles for carrying things is a ___.
Which word BEGINS with the 'wh' sound?
questions.hint: Look for the word spelled with 'wh' at the start

sections.title: Initial 'st' Sound
sections.description: The 'st' sound at the START of a word — as in 'star'

questions.prompt: It shines brightly in the sky at night. It is a ___.
We ___ up when the teacher comes into the room.
Bad weather with heavy rain, wind and thunder is a ___.
The place where a train stops for people is a ___.
Which word BEGINS with the 'st' sound?
questions.hint: Look for the word spelled with 'st' at the start

questions.prompt: A sea animal shaped like a star is a ___.
We must ___ when the traffic light turns red.

sections.title: Final 'st' Sound
sections.description: The 'st' sound at the END of a word — as in 'forest'

questions.prompt: A large place with many trees growing together is a ___.
A soft home where a bird lays its eggs is a ___.
When something is better than all the others, it is the ___.
Bread that is heated until it is brown and crispy is ___.
Which word ENDS with the 'st' sound?
questions.hint: Look for the word that finishes with 'st'

questions.prompt: A person who comes to visit your home is a ___.
Land that is right next to the sea is called the ___.

sections.title: Medial 'st' Sound
sections.description: The 'st' sound in the MIDDLE of a word — as in 'hamster'

questions.prompt: A small furry pet, like a little mouse, kept in a cage is a ___.
questions.hint: ham-ST-er has the 'st' sound in the middle

questions.prompt: A scary make-believe creature in stories is a ___.
A sea animal with big claws that turns red when it is cooked is a ___.
questions.hint: lob-ST-er has the 'st' sound in the middle

questions.prompt: The colour some people put on their lips is called ___.
Which word has the 'st' sound in the MIDDLE?
questions.hint: The 'st' is between other letters, not at the start or end

questions.prompt: Fill the blank: The mon___er in the story had big teeth.
questions.hint: The word is 'monster' — 'st' goes in the middle
